summary: Solution finder after IRIS: centered heading, then a vertical list of 2-4 ways to browse (by service, by company size, by industry) on the left, the active one marked by a thick brand-colour bar, and a raised white panel overlapping it on the right with that tab's 2-6 solution cards in two columns. Each card has an optional photo at its side, a title in the brand or dark ink (alternating), a short paragraph and a See more link. On tablets and phones the ways to browse become a row of pills above the panel.
